value_streams.name: Member Engagement & Retention
value_streams.description: Deliver a compelling membership experience that attracts prospective business analysis professionals, onboards them, provides ongoing value and encourages membership renewal. Membership benefits include career development tools, interactive versions of the BABOK/Agile Extension and discounts on certifications. Members can network through chapters and hundreds of events and access knowledge resources .

value_streams.name: Certification & Credential Lifecycle
value_streams.description: Provide a globally recognised credentialing pathway that assesses and certifies business analysis competencies. IIBA certifications are promoted as a way to gain career growth, increased earning potential and recognition. Reasons for pursuing certification include industry recognition, career advancement, skill enhancement and networking opportunities

value_streams.name: Knowledge & Standards Curation
value_streams.description: Develop, maintain and disseminate authoritative knowledge and standards that underpin the business analysis profession. IIBA publishes the BABOK Guide, which it calls “the globally recognised standard for the practice of business analysis” , and the Business Analysis Standard, described as the backbone of professional practice that provides a simplified, comprehensive view of business analysis concepts . It also operates the KnowledgeHub, giving members instant online access to the BABOK Guide plus community driven content, such as ‘how do I’ scenarios, videos, tips, tools and templates. Thought leadership white papers and studies are published in collaboration with industry partners to provide guidance and best practices to address digital transformation, agile and new technologies.

value_streams.name: Community & Volunteer Engagement
value_streams.description: Nurture a vibrant global community of practitioners through local chapters, events, webinars, networking, mentorship and volunteer opportunities. IIBA has “120 chapters in over 40 countries” and chapter membership is described as a “global pass to hundreds of events”. Volunteers play a major role: thousands of IIBA members contribute to the global business analysis community as volunteers and they have opportunities to give back while developing their skills and earning CDUs. Webinars allow members to learn something new, stay informed and connect with the global community, and participants can earn CDUs.

value_streams.name: Partner & Institutional Engagement
value_streams.description: Build and maintain relationships with corporate, government, academic and training partners to promote the adoption of business analysis practices within organisations. The Partner Program emphasises resource tailoring, membership and certification packages, networking roundtables and feedback loops: partners can “access resources tailored to your organisation,” “gain more memberships and certifications at every program level,” “join roundtables and events to network with professionals,” and “share your thoughts directly with IIBA’s Product Team”. The program reports that 95 % of partners supporting professional development see improvements, 93 % use feedback to improve processes and 86 % report better quality and more effective BA deliverables. The three tier structure offers flexible certification options, collaborative roundtables, expert led learning events, certification tools and membership management.

value_streams.name: Thought Leadership & Advocacy
value_streams.description: Advance the business analysis profession by generating and disseminating thought leadership and advocacy. IIBA’s global thought leadership programme publishes white papers and studies in collaboration with industry influencers and partner organisations ; webinars provide expert led insights on leadership, certification preparation and fundamentals. These activities drive awareness of emerging practices and advocate for the value of business analysis within organisations and across industries.
